name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Run.trans
typeText:
∀ {P : List.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Instr} {c₁ c₂ c₃ : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Cfg} {n₁ n₂ t₁ t₂ : Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Run P c₁ c₂ n₁ t₁ →
    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Run P c₂ c₃ n₂ t₂ →
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Run P c₁ c₃ (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n₁ n₂) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} t₁ t₂)

source.code:
theorem Run.trans {P : List Instr} {c₁ c₂ c₃ : Cfg} {n₁ n₂ t₁ t₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : Run P c₁ c₂ n₁ t₁) (h₂ : Run P c₂ c₃ n₂ t₂) : Run P c₁ c₃ (n₁ + n₂) (t₁ + t₂) := by
  induction h₁ with
  | refl c => simpa using h₂
  | @step c c₁ c₂ k n t hs _ ih =>
      have e1 : n + 1 + n₂ = (n + n₂) + 1 := by omega
      have e2 : k + t + t₂ = k + (t + t₂) := by omega
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact Run.step hs (ih h₂)
